    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersLuke's lemon dill salmon skewersMarinated salmon chunks grilled on skewers, with a dill yoghurt dipHow to make it600g salmon fillet, skin off2 lemons, juiced3 tbsp chopped dill, plus extra for the dip3 tbsp olive oil300g Greek yoghurtCut the salmon into chunks and marinate in the lemon juice, dill and oil for 20 minutes.Thread onto skewers and grill for 2 minutes a side.Stir more dill and lemon through the yoghurt for a dip.Crait red salt chipsPaper-thin fried potato chips with sea salt and smoked paprikaHow to make it800g potatoes1 L vegetable oil1 tsp sea salt flakes2 tsp smoked paprikaSlice the potatoes paper thin on a mandoline and rinse well. Dry thoroughly.Fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C in batches until crisp and golden.Toss straight away with salt and smoked paprika so the red shows through like the salt flats.Canto Bight prosciutto gorgonzola figsThe glitzy casino city of Canto BightHow to make itAs written, serves 4Fresh figs split and filled with gorgonzola, wrapped in prosciutto and blistered under the grill, finished with hot honey and cracked pepper on a gold tray.Cut a cross in the top of 12 fresh figs and press about 10g gorgonzola into each, 120g in all.Wrap each fig in half a slice of prosciutto.Grill on a lined tray for 5 minutes until the prosciutto crisps and the cheese melts.Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes and drizzle over.Finish with cracked pepper and thyme leaves.Line-caught fish grilled on the coalsLuke spears it off the cliffs, porgs watching.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsResistance chicken rice bowlsLemon oregano chicken, roast red pepper, cucumber and feta over riceHow to make it800g chicken thighs2 lemons, juiced1 tbsp dried oregano3 tbsp olive oil300g long grain rice2 red capsicums1 Lebanese cucumber, diced100g feta, crumbled3 tbsp tahiniMarinate the chicken in lemon juice, oregano and oil while the oven heats.Roast the capsicums at 220°C until soft and blistered, then peel and slice into strips.Cook the rice. Grill the chicken until cooked through, then slice.Build bowls of rice with the chicken, capsicum, cucumber and feta and drizzle with tahini.Chewie's not-a-porg roast poussinChewie roasting his dinner over the fire as the porgs stareHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole spatchcocked poussins rubbed with garlic, thyme and smoked paprika, charred over the coals, with crisp smashed potatoes and lemony greens.No porgs harmed.Cut the backbones out of 4 poussins and press flat.Rub with 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme, 2 tsp smoked paprika, olive oil and salt.Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220°C for 35 minutes.Grill or roast the poussins at 220°C for 30 minutes until the juices run clear.Wilt a bunch of kale with lemon and garlic.SweetsGreen pistachio milk panna cottaPistachio panna cotta set in glasses with crushed pistachios and honeyHow to make it100g pistachios, plus extra crushed to serve250ml milk300ml thickened cream80g caster sugar3 gelatine sheets, soaked2 tbsp honeyBlend the pistachios with the milk until fine, then strain.Warm the pistachio milk with the cream and sugar. Stir in the soaked gelatine until dissolved.Pour into glasses and set overnight.Top with crushed pistachios and a drizzle of honey.DrinksThrone room red punchLet the past die. Cranberry and pomegranate juice, soda water, no alcoholHow to make it1 L cranberry juice1 L pomegranate juice1 L soda water1 pomegranate, seeds only1 bag iceFill tall glasses with ice and a spoon of pomegranate seeds.Pour in equal parts cranberry and pomegranate juice to halfway, then top with soda water.Stir once so it swirls deep red.Hot nettle and honey teaRey's lightsaber, tossed back over Luke's shoulder.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
